intro.text: A king of an unknown land on Roshar who came to the throne very young.

items.text: Gregorh became king as a boy and started a pointless war against kingdoms that had been allies of his father. His foolishness was infamous in the Era of Solitude.
Shallan Davar cited Gregorh to Jasnah Kholin to show that youthful immaturity does not always bring about good change.
